items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, by default it only types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level since it allows combined usage with other general purpose JSON decoders like JacksonCborHttpMessageConverter without conflicts.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，默认情况下仅支持在类型或泛型级别上标注了@Serializable的类型，因为它允许与其他通用 JSON 解码器（如JacksonCborHttpMessageConverter）结合使用且不会产生冲突。

items.source: Alternative constructors with a Predicate<ResolvableType> parameter can be used to customize this behavior. For example, new KotlinSerializationCborHttpMessageConverter(type -> true) will decode all types supported by Kotlin Serialization, including unannotated Kotlin enumerations, numbers, characters, booleans and strings.
items.translation: 带有 `Predicate<ResolvableType>` 参数的替代构造函数可用于自定义此行为。例如，`new KotlinSerializationCborHttpMessageConverter(type -> true)` 将解码 Kotlin Serialization 支持的所有类型，包括未注释的 Kotlin 枚举、数字、字符、布尔值和字符串。

items.source: Construct a new converter using Cbor.Default instance which only converts types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 使用 `Cbor.Default` 实例构建一个新的转换器，该转换器仅转换在类型或泛型级别上标注了 `@Serializable` 的类型。

items.source: Construct a new converter using Cbor.Default instance which only converts types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 使用 `Cbor.Default` 实例构建一个新的转换器，该转换器仅转换指定谓词返回 `true` 的类型。

items.source: Construct a new converter using the provided Cbor instance which only converts types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 使用提供的 `Cbor` 实例构建一个新的转换器，该转换器仅转换在类型或泛型级别上标注了 `@Serializable` 的类型。

items.source: Construct a new converter using the provided Cbor instance which only converts types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 使用提供的 `Cbor` 实例构建一个新的转换器，该转换器仅转换指定谓词返回 `true` 的类型。
